“Hi, I’m Srija, a regular at Starbucks, and this is where one of the most unforgettable moments of my life happened.

I still remember the day I was sitting at my usual corner seat at Starbucks, nervously refreshing my inbox, waiting for that one email. And then, there it was. ‘Congratulations! You’ve got the job!’ My heart raced, my hands trembled, and before I knew it, I let out a small cheer. 

The baristas noticed my excitement and asked what had happened. When I told them, they celebrated with me in the best way possible. They handed me my drink, and this time, there was a handwritten message on the tray that said, 'Congrats, Srija!!' with a smiley doodled next to it. I was so moved. That small yet thoughtful gesture made my day even more special. 

From that moment on, Starbucks became more than just my go-to coffee spot—it became my place of comfort, celebration, and motivation. Every week, I kept coming back, forming a bond with the amazing baristas who had unknowingly become a part of my journey.

Some places serve coffee, but Starbucks? It serves memories. And for that, I’ll always be grateful. 💚☕”

“I’m Vishakha, a proud and regular customer of Starbucks, and this is my story. Starbucks Lokhandwala, Andheri, will always hold a special place in my heart because it’s where it all began. I met him, my now husband for the very first time here. 
 
What started as a casual meet-up over their best-curated menu turned into a six-hour conversation filled with laughter, connection, and a spark that changed my life. The funniest part? Even on this life-changing date, I stuck to my all-time favourite, the Java Chip Hazelnut Frappuccino. That day marked the beginning of our love story.
 
Fast forward to today, we’ve been happily married for three years and are now parents to a little one. And guess what? My baby’s first outing was at the Gamdevi Starbucks, it’s become a part of our family’s journey now.
 
Starbucks has been with me through every milestone, and it will always be special to us. Cheers to #BrewedToA100 and beyond!”

Hi, I’m Taramani, and I’m a Shift Supervisor at the Madgaon store in Goa. I started as a Barista when Starbucks opened its first store here, and every day since has been a journey of mastering the art of coffee, connecting with customers, and discovering myself. 
 
Three years in, I’ve grown from someone uncertain about the future to someone who now leads a team. Today, I’m proud to say this isn’t just a job, it’s helping me save up to pursue an MBA and get closer to my dream of buying my parents a house.

When I left home at 17, I wasn’t sure where life would take me. But I chose to trust myself and that made all the difference.
“Trust matters. In yourself, in your journey, and in the people who stand by you.”
 
To me, Starbucks is about purpose, possibility, and finding the courage to build the life you’ve always dreamed of.
 
#StarbucksIndia #ToBeAPartner

Every Starbucks coffee begins its journey long before it reaches your hands. It starts with the bean. 🌱

We believe the bean matters because quality can’t be roasted in. It’s nurtured from the very beginning. That is why we source 100% arabica beans from high-altitude farms in India and around the world. These ideal growing conditions help develop flavour, density, and complexity in every bean.

That’s how we bring the world’s finest coffee beans to you. It’s crafted with intention, rooted in expertise, and tells a story of craftsmanship, responsibility, and quality in every cup.

We had flown back to India from the UK for a wedding, when I realised, I had to ask the woman I love to marry me. On the day, I told her we were going shopping and made a quick coffee stop. As we sat at the chosen table, suddenly, the guitarist began playing. She looked up, startled, and then I began to sing. A decade later, as we are celebrating 10 years of our marriage, Starbucks is celebrating 500 stores in India. Even in London, every time we visit Starbucks, it reminds us of that special moment.
